# Product repo root — generated by `ember new`.
# Build: ./scripts/build.sh -> ./build/<model>/bin/
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(__PRODUCT_SLUG__ VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX C)

if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/config.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Generate the model configuration first: ember genconfig --product <model> --build-dir <build-dir>")
endif()

file(STRINGS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/product.default" _default_model LIMIT_COUNT 1)
set(OPENEMBER_PRODUCT_MODEL "${_default_model}" CACHE STRING "Active product model")
message(STATUS "Product model: ${OPENEMBER_PRODUCT_MODEL}")

set(OPENEMBER_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/openember" CACHE PATH
    "OpenEmber source tree")
if(NOT EXISTS "${OPENEMBER_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "OpenEmber source tree not found: ${OPENEMBER_DIR}")
endif()

add_subdirectory("${OPENEMBER_DIR}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/_deps/openember-build")
if(DEFINED PRODUCT_MODEL AND NOT PRODUCT_MODEL STREQUAL OPENEMBER_PRODUCT_MODEL)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Configuration model differs from selected model; use ember --product")
endif()
add_custom_target(openember_product ALL)
if(TARGET launch_manager)
    add_dependencies(openember_product launch_manager)
endif()

add_subdirectory(modules)
add_subdirectory(apps/product_app)
